import bpy,json,collections
from mathutils import Vector
c=bpy.data.collections['Shipyard_COMBINED_Craft']
rs=[]
for o in c.objects:
 if o.type=='MESH' and o.data.materials and o.data.materials[0].name=='SP13_WeatheredBlueSteel':
  ps=[o.matrix_world@Vector(v) for v in o.bound_box]
  rs.append({'name':o.name,'min':[round(min(p[i] for p in ps),3) for i in range(3)],'max':[round(max(p[i] for p in ps),3) for i in range(3)]})
print(json.dumps({'total':len(rs),'names':dict(collections.Counter(r['name'].split('.')[0] for r in rs if not r['name'].startswith('Steel roof panel'))),'roof_bounds':[[min(r['min'][i] for r in rs if r['name'].startswith('Steel roof panel')),max(r['max'][i] for r in rs if r['name'].startswith('Steel roof panel'))] for i in range(3)]},ensure_ascii=False))
